title: The Officialism and Officials of the Government Paper Manufactory (Jojiseo) in the Joseon Period
lineage: Brief paraphrased research notes, not a source copy.

passages.note: The English abstract says Jojiso was established in 1415 to manufacture paper for government and tribute and to practice and improve paper techniques; it reports renaming in 1466 and discusses oversight of quality and local manufacturers over the office history.
